items.title: Tyner McCoy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Mike Cuscuna was there too, with Bruce Lundvall

ctx.x: And what else? There was something else they called it too. See this is why I need my youngest son, because Mike Cuscuna was there too, with Bruce Lundvall right in New York, but I know Manhattan was a part of that.
The thing is, my memory is the last song I wrote (laughs).
